title: What telescope could cause our astrophotography expert to break their hard-and-fast rule about not traveling with a telescope? This one! Now even cheaper in this Prime Day telescope deal
summary: Ready to turn your skywatching upside-down? Then snap up this ZWO Seestar S30 Pro, which offers views so stunning it made our expert bin their no telescope rule.
contentText:
Our astrophotography expert, Jamie Carter, has reviewed countless telescopes and optics equipment for us but always maintained a no travel rule when it comes to telescopes. All that changed when they reviewed the ZWO SeeStar S30 Pro, and this Prime Day, it's $35 cheaper.

Get the ZWO Seestar S30 Pro telescope on sale right now at Amazon for $664 .

That's not to say the ZWO Seestar S30 Pro is just for deep space; it's a superb all-round smart telescope and we think the previous model, the ZWO Seestar S30, is one of the best telescopes and best smart telescopes.

But what made it just a game-changer for our expert was that, eschewing the bulk of normal telescopes, he could pack it into his camera bag as he explored New Brunswick's dark-sky corridor . He was absolutely stunned by the views of the Whirlpool Galaxy that popped up on his smartphone.

If you want to be similarly awed, snap up the ZWO Seestar S30 Pro and don't forget to check out the other Prime Day Deals on offer.

Jamie used the SeeStar S30 Pro when on location in New Brunswick. (Image credit: Jamie Carter) The ZWO Seestar S30 is a superb smart telescope, featuring in our best beginner telescopes and best telescope guides, and now ZWO has taken things to the next level with the upgrade, the S30 Pro.

Our expert called the ZWO Seestar S30 Pro a life-changing device. Why? Because it's small enough to fit in a camera bag and yet, it's a impressive alternative to the best cameras for astrophotography.

Venturing into a dark sky zone, he captured some stunning images, including the Whirlpool Galaxy.

"In the smart telescope era, traveling light doesn't have to mean leaving a telescope behind," he remarked, now convert to smart scopes.

It captures 8.3MP / 4K images and side from the telescope itself, comes with a mini-tripod, shoulder strap and bag. You do operate it via a smartphone, and view images on its display, which may not be to everyone's taste.

But if the ZWO Seestar S30 Pro can convert Jamie, our expert astrophotographer, it can convert anyone.
